list.name: channel
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT channel_name AS __text, channel_id AS __value FROM v_vlc_bitrate WHERE time > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, channel_name || ' ' || field AS metric, bitrate AS value FROM v_vlc_bitrate WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND channel_id ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY 1
SELECT time, channel_name AS metric, frame_drop_rate FROM v_vlc_frame_drop_rate WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND channel_id ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Video frames (decoded / displayed / lost) per sec

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, channel_name || ' ' || field AS metric, frames_per_second FROM v_vlc_video_frames WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND channel_id ~ '${channel:regex}' ORDER BY 1
SELECT time, channel_id, field, value_num FROM metric_influx_samples WHERE measurement = 'vlc_metrics' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200
